name: Historical LCOE and cost trend series spanning the 2016–2026 retrospective window
description: Annual benchmark series provide the only readable dated cost trend evidence covering the full decade. Lazard's historical chart is an analyst series; EIA figures are government assumptions with explicitly stated dollar years. Values from different dollar years are not converted.
